-- Lavande - Linalol
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage_typical, percentage_min, percentage_max, role, is_signature, source)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 35.0, 25.0, 45.0, 'majeur', 1, 'Tisserand & Young (2014). Essential Oil Safety'
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Lavande%' AND m.name LIKE '%Linalol%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.plant_id = p.id AND pm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Lavande - Camphre
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage_typical, percentage_min, percentage_max, role, source)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 5.0, 2.0, 10.0, 'secondaire', 'Tisserand & Young (2014). Essential Oil Safety'
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Lavande%' AND m.name LIKE '%Camphre%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.plant_id = p.id AND pm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Menthe - Menthol
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage_typical, percentage_min, percentage_max, role, is_signature, source)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 45.0, 30.0, 55.0, 'majeur', 1, 'Tisserand & Young (2014). Essential Oil Safety'
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Menthe%' AND m.name LIKE '%Menthol%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.plant_id = p.id AND pm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Eucalyptus - 1,8-Cinéole
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage_typical, percentage_min, percentage_max, role, is_signature, source)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 70.0, 60.0, 85.0, 'majeur', 1, 'Tisserand & Young (2014). Essential Oil Safety'
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Eucalyptus%' AND (m.name LIKE '%Cinéole%' OR m.name LIKE '%Cineole%')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.plant_id = p.id AND pm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;
